volume_ratio_source.kind: committed Hirshfeld row (PySCF+numpy mirror of ferric's lattice volumes)

keywords.target_screening: plain SCS: (diag(1/alpha(iu)) + T_gg)^-1, T_gg = pymbd.pymbd.T_erf_coulomb, sigma=(sqrt(2/pi) alpha/3)^(1/3); libmbd variant='scs'
keywords.target_energy: plain MBD, damping 'dip,gg', static TS alpha/omega; libmbd variant='plain'
keywords.rsscs_targets: MBD@rsSCS beta in (0.83, 0.85), a=6, pymbd 15-node grid; pymbd python + libmbd variant='rsscs' (alpha_0_scs/C6_scs intermediates); R_vdw = ferric ts_free_atom_r_vdw * ratio^(1/3)
keywords.rsscs_gradient: libmbd variant='rsscs' force=True, stored as dE/dR (Hartree/Bohr, TS alpha_0/C6/R_vdw fixed); convention decided by central FD of libmbd's energy (h=0.0001 Bohr), see runs[*].gradient_fd_check
keywords.ts_c6: Casimir-Polder quadrature on the stored grids + closed-form combination rule
keywords.free_atom_table: ferric ts_free_atom (parsed from free_atom_ref.rs) == pymbd vdw_params TS
